market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver at ~$34 would need to triple to $120 in about a year, a move far exceeding any historical surge (all-time high $50). Even under extreme scenarios the probability is well below 1%, making the market's 6.7% implied chance heavily overpriced.
evidence_points: Silver's all-time high is ~$50 (1980, 2011), requiring an unprecedented >3x rally to $120 in one year.
No fundamental macro or monetary shift currently suggests such an extreme move is remotely likely.
The CME settlement rule only considers official active-month settlement prices, making intraday spikes irrelevant and further restraining the path to a resolution.
Historical volatility and options skew imply tail probabilities for such a move are under 1%.
sources_consulted: CME Silver futures historical settlement prices
Silver price history and all-time high data
Current macroeconomic and monetary policy outlook
